mechanism: Diclofenac may increase primaquine levels through CYP2C8 inhibition and reduce renal clearance, while primaquine's oxidative metabolites combined with NSAIDs increase hemolytic risk in G6PD-deficient patients.
action: Monitor for hemolysis signs (jaundice, dark urine, fatigue) and consider alternative antimalarial or NSAID; ensure G6PD status is known before co-prescription.
